newsitem.title: UK: GKN up on broker "buy," chief exec ups stake.
newsitem.headline: GKN up on broker "buy," chief exec ups stake.

text.p: Shares in engineering group GKN Plc rose on Tuesday as analysts at Merrill Lynch repeated a "buy" recommendation and the engineering group's chief executive added to his stake in the company, dealers said.
The stock was up 15p at 964-1/2 by 1345 GMT -- extending a rebound since the 13-month low of 905p set on April 24.
Analysts at Merrill were not immediately available for comment.
In a statement, GKN said chief executive CK Chow bought 3,000 shares at 956p, taking his total holding to 5,033 shares.
GKN shares suffered a setback last week amid renewed concerns about legal action from franchisees of its Meineke Discount Muffler Shops unit in the United States.
A Meineke franchisee at last week's annual meeting said a group of franchisees who had been excluded from GKN's legal settlement were preparing to file a lawsuit to be reincluded in the class action.
GKN declined comment on the threat.
